products.name: Pitch AI
products.note: Presentation software AI; collaboration; template generation; EU-hosted

profile_text.body:
Pitch is a collaborative presentation platform aimed at teams that need to create, share, and deliver slide-based work at scale. The company describes itself as an AI presentation workspace, and its site emphasizes features for maintaining brand consistency across teams, including shared templates, a brand library, and design controls intended to keep slides uniform as usage grows.

The company's primary product, Pitch AI, sits within the slides and presentations category and is hosted in the EU. It allows users to generate on-brand slides using AI, start from a blank canvas, choose from more than 150 fully customizable templates crafted by design experts, or import existing PPTX files. The platform positions AI as a workflow aid that adapts to a team's existing processes rather than replacing manual design control.

The held facts note that Pitch is tracked under a single product entry with no associated litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations on record at this time.
